issues.title: Raw SQL via prisma.$executeRawUnsafe
issues.description: Use of prisma.$executeRawUnsafe to write JSONB fields from uploaded/admin data; risk of SQL injection or malformed queries.
issues.recommendation: Replace with parameterized Prisma APIs (`prisma.$executeRaw` with template binding) or use Prisma's JSON field `update` methods. Validate and sanitize inputs.

issues.title: Firebase admin private key handling and logging
issues.description: Private key read from env and debug-logged (key length). Logging secret-derived metadata can leak sensitive information.
issues.recommendation: Remove logging, load service account JSON from a secret manager, and ensure key newline handling is robust. Restrict log access in production.

issues.title: Secrets in environment variables across multiple libs
issues.description: Multiple server-side API keys and connection strings are read directly from process.env. Ensure they are provisioned securely and not leaked in code or CI logs.
issues.recommendation: Use a secrets manager, restrict access, rotate keys, and audit IAM/ACLs.

issues.title: Client-side session token exposure
issues.description: Session tokens stored in JavaScript state and sent via `x-session-token` header are accessible to XSS attacks.
issues.recommendation: Use HttpOnly, Secure cookies for sessions where possible; if not, harden XSS protections, shorten token lifetime, and implement refresh/rotation.

issues.title: Upstash REST token scope
issues.description: Upstash REST token in env can allow high-privilege access if leaked.
issues.recommendation: Use ACLs, limited tokens, private networking, and rotate tokens.
